module: Execution engine of the "Thumbnail Composer" (v2): orchestrates a series of vehicle thumbnail captures for a calling UI (identified by ownerId) that receives events via a table of handlers. It validates the targets (thumbnailTargets), optionally filters out those that already have a thumbnail (missingOnly), takes control of the physics, applies reference graphics settings for the duration of the job (Ultra quality, SMAA, no motion blur, no occupants…), then processes each item in a coroutine (thumbnailCapturePipeline.processWorkItem). It also handles a camera preview, a depth-of-field background blur tuned to the showroom's back wall, a forced exposure, and the "Showroom Tools" ImGui panel (drawShowroomTools) of the showroom_thumbnails flowgraph.
notes: Events emitted to handlers.emit(ownerId, name, data): Status, Catalog, Progress {runId, stage = "capture", completed, total, current}, ItemResult {runId, itemId, index, total, current, status...}, RunComplete {runId}, Failed {runId, error, cancelled}. Handler errors are caught (pcall) and logged.

Only one job at a time: start returns false and emits Failed if a capture is already in progress, if the targets are invalid, if missingOnly leaves nothing to do or if the physics cannot be taken over.

Message options for start: targets (list {model, config}; absent = player vehicle's config), captureMode ("defaults" = default.jpg, otherwise one thumbnail per config), missingOnly, outputWidth/outputHeight (16 to 8192, default 500x281), backgroundBlur (0 to 1), blurStartDistance (0.5 to 30 m, default 8), forceExposure, exposureEV (default 8.3).
The original graphics settings are saved (settings.getValue) and restored at the end, on cancellation or on unload; the showroom environment is restored via util_screenshotCreator_settings.

The background blur casts a ray (Engine.castRay) from the camera to find the wall and sets DOFPostEffect (focalDist, farSlope…) every frame; the exposure uses PostEffectLocalExposureObject. These two effects are active only during a preview or a job.
The first failure of an item stops the whole job (failRun); cancellation emits Failed with cancelled = true.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before: ui_imgui and util_screenshotCreator_settings, lightingSetup, thumbnailCapturePipeline, thumbnailConfig, thumbnailPaths, thumbnailTargets.

onClientEndMission.desc: Alias of onExtensionUnloaded: cleans up at the end of the level.

onExit.desc: Alias of onExtensionUnloaded: cleans up when the game closes.

start.desc: Starts a capture job for the caller ownerId. Resolves the targets, applies the capture settings and starts the work coroutine. Returns false (and emits "Failed") on refusal.

message.desc: Options: targets, captureMode, missingOnly, outputWidth, outputHeight, backgroundBlur, blurStartDistance, forceExposure, exposureEV.

handlers.desc: {emit = function(ownerId, name, data)} that receives the events.

cancel.desc: Cancels the current job (emits Failed with cancelled = true). If ownerId is given, it must match the job's caller.

returns.desc: true if a job was canceled.

isActive.desc: Indicates whether a job is in progress (for this ownerId if specified).

sendStatus.desc: Emits the Status event: {active, runId, currentModel, currentConfig, currentFlipped} (currentFlipped = 180° thumbnail rotation).

subscribe.desc: Registers a caller: emits Status then Catalog {models = vehicle catalog, resolutions = resolution presets}.

setViewOptions.desc: Sets the view options (background blur, blur start distance, forced exposure) from a message.

startPreview.desc: Preview: places the player's free camera on the framing computed for the player vehicle (the pipeline's legacy framing) and adjusts the lighting. Does nothing if there is no vehicle or if a job is active.

stopPreview.desc: Ends the preview: restores the stored camera state and the lighting.

drawShowroomTools.desc: Draws in the flowgraph's ImGui window the thumbnail tools panel: blur and exposure options, resolution, vehicle selection grid, "Capture current config", "Capture all configs" and "Capture missing thumbnails" buttons, progress bar and Cancel button.

onPreRender.desc: Hook called every frame before rendering: advances the work coroutine (an error makes it fail) and updates the DOF blur and the forced exposure during a preview or a job.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Unload hook: stops the job, restores the exposure, the blur, the graphics settings, the environment and the physics.
